tonal_mismatches.line_excerpt: They'd stood at a distance, as their disease required, and cried out, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us."
tonal_mismatches.rationale: The beat opens on a desperate collective cry for mercy before settling into the flat command; matter-of-fact undersells the plea, though it does fit the command line that follows in the same beat.

concerns: The lepers' collective cry ('Jesus, Master, have mercy on us') has no roster speaker and correctly stays as narrator-delivered quoted speech; flagging only so the narrator's read doesn't flatten it relative to the attributed jesus lines.

Beat 2 carries two tonal registers (a plea, then a flat command) under one tag pair — acceptable for a 60s short, but the narrator/director should be aware the tag applies loosely across the whole beat.
